g.text: FarField Remote Jumps: How a New Idea Emerges
Trace technical progress, identify a bottleneck, and transfer a mechanism into a new method
Input: research intent, existing methods and literature, and prior findings when available
Trigger: first idea / stagnation / branch diversification
Model sketches; sources check changes and limits
Extract mechanism, sources, assumptions and limits
Revise, defer, or reject any or all candidates
Source domain: how the mechanism operates
Target problem: reconstruct a new method
Preserve: structural, causal or constraint relations
Turn a borrowed mechanism into a target design
Search, read and revise around specific knowledge gaps
Target bottleneck B + transferred mechanism M′
A proposed idea; effectiveness awaits investigation
Prior observations revise bottlenecks and transfer conditions, guiding the next jump or local refinement
Allocate effort by conditional value, unresolved questions and test cost; distance only broadens retrieval.
Intended mechanism: current retrieval may return concepts only; mechanism grounding and landing verification remain incomplete.
